items.name: Evidence
items.description: verify one public claim, identify its source and denominator, and record what remains uncertain.

items.name: Law and jurisdiction
items.description: correct one owner/remedy map and explain the governing procedure.

items.name: Research and data
items.description: audit public records, clean datasets or examine repeated service failures without exposing personal identities.

items.name: Language and communication
items.description: translate one issue brief into Marathi, Hindi or another relevant language; check meaning with users.

items.name: Accessibility
items.description: review an intake journey or document with disabled participants and compensate specialist review where possible.

items.name: Design and software
items.description: test a synthetic intake/appeal workflow for routing, privacy, failure recovery and harmful automation.

items.name: Deliberation
items.description: facilitate a small remote session that records evidence, counterarguments, agreement and dissent.

items.name: On-ground connection
items.description: ask affected people what the draft misunderstands; relay their corrections with consent and attribution preferences.

fields: effort and availability chosen by the contributor
form.caveat: Do not imply that a volunteer promises unpaid professional legal representation or indefinite support.
